channel.title: ApprovalPrep — letter and checklist kits
channel.description: Self-service letter templates and checklists for rental applications, loans, credit letters, employment verification and everyday paperwork.

items.title: Letter of Explanation Template Kit — 9 situations, editable DOCX
items.description: Letter of explanation templates for credit, income gaps, employment gaps, address history, late payments, bank statements and life events. A PDF guide plus editable DOCX letters you fill in yourself. Self-service: we never contact anyone for you or promise approval.

items.title: Employment Verification and Proof of Income Letter Kit
items.description: Employment verification, proof of income, self-employment income, job change and employment gap letters in one self-service kit. Fill in the templates yourself and attach your real documents. Editable DOCX plus a PDF guide.

items.title: Credit Letter Templates — dispute, goodwill, late payment, debt validation
items.description: DIY credit letter templates for possible report errors, goodwill requests, late payments, debt validation and follow-up. You write and send the letters yourself. Not credit repair and no promised results. Editable DOCX plus a PDF guide.

items.title: Rental Application Checklist and Letter Kit for Apartment Hunting
items.description: Get your apartment application packet complete before you apply: a rental checklist, cover letter guidance, and letters for rental history, income and employment questions. Self-service, editable DOCX plus a PDF guide.

items.title: Loan Application Letter Kit — explain credit, income and bank statements
items.description: Letters and checklists to prepare before an auto loan, personal loan or mortgage review: explain credit history, income, job changes and bank statement questions clearly. Self-service; we are not a lender and never promise approval.

items.title: Business Loan and SBA Prep Kit — checklists and lender letters
items.description: Organize business documents, explain income and bank activity, describe use of funds and prepare lender follow-up letters. For business loan and SBA prep. Self-service; not a lender, broker or accountant. Editable DOCX plus a PDF guide.

items.title: Life Admin Letter Kit — address, residency and document request letters
items.description: Simple letters and checklists for everyday paperwork: address history, residency, identity details, account issues and document requests to a school, employer, landlord or agency. Self-service, editable DOCX plus a PDF guide.

items.title: Letter Template Bundle — rental, credit, income, loan and business kits
items.description: Every ApprovalPrep kit in one download: rental application, credit letters, income and employment proof, loan prep, business funding prep and everyday paperwork letters. Self-service templates and checklists; you prepare and send your own.

items.title: Employment Verification Letter: what to include, with a free template
items.description: What an employment verification letter should include, the employer and employee versions, and a checklist of the fields a landlord or lender reviewer may need. A plain guide with a free template.

items.title: SBA Loan Checklist: documents lenders ask for
items.description: The documents an SBA lender typically asks for — tax returns, financial statements, business plan, debt schedule, ownership and use of funds — as a checklist you can work through before you apply.

items.title: How to Get Approved for an Apartment: checklist and tips
items.description: What landlords check on a rental application — income, rental history, credit and references — and how to prepare each one honestly before you apply. A plain checklist-style guide.
